constructor for GTEx examples

GTExresource.Rd

constructor for GTEx examples

Usage

GTExresource(con, space = "hg19", tisstag, pfile)

Arguments

con

DBI connection

space

character(1) must indicate build

tisstag

character(1) string for tissue name

pfile

character(1) path to parquet file

Note

'score' is p-value

Examples

fo = ggi_gtex_cache("lungpl05.parquet")
#> resource BFC1040 already in cache from https://mghp.osn.xsede.org/bir190004-bucket01/BiocGGIData/lungpl05.parquet
if (nchar(fo)>0) {
  lungpa = fo
  con = DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  lu = GTExresource(con, tisstag="lung", pfile=lungpa)
  lu
# please do dbDisconnect(con) when done with 'lu'
}
